sentences.text: Naples -LRB- -LSB- ˈneɪpəlz -RSB- Napoli -LSB- ˈnaːpoli -RSB- , Neapolitan : Napule -LSB- - napˈnɑːpələ -RSB- or -LSB- - napˈnɑːpulə -RSB- Neapolis Νεάπολις , meaning `` new city '' -RRB- is the capital of the Italian region Campania and the third-largest municipality in Italy , after Rome and Milan .	Campania	Campania	Neapolitan	Neapolitan language	Rome	Rome	Milan	Milan
In 2015 , around 975,260 people lived within the city 's administrative limits .
The Metropolitan City of Naples had a population of 3,115,320 .	Metropolitan City of Naples	Metropolitan City of Naples

Naples is the 9th-most populous urban area in the European Union with a population of between 3 million and 3.7 million .	9th-most populous urban area	Largest urban areas of the European Union	European Union	European Union

About 4.4 million people live in the Naples metropolitan area , one of the largest metropolises on the Mediterranean Sea .	Naples metropolitan area	Naples metropolitan area	Mediterranean Sea	Mediterranean Sea
Naples is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world .	oldest continuously inhabited cities	List of cities by time of continuous habitation
Bronze Age Greek settlements were established in the Naples area in the second millennium BC .	Bronze Age	Bronze Age	second millennium BC	2nd millennium BC

A larger colony -- initially known as Parthenope , Παρθενόπη -- developed on the Island of Megaride around the ninth century BC , at the end of the Greek Dark Ages .	Island of Megaride	Castel dell'Ovo	Greek Dark Ages	Greek Dark Ages

The city was refounded as Neápolis in the sixth century BC and became a lynchpin of Magna Graecia , playing a key role in the merging of Greek culture into Roman society and eventually becoming a cultural centre of the Roman Republic .	Magna Graecia	Magna Graecia	Greek culture	Greek culture	Roman Republic	Roman Republic

Naples remained influential after the fall of the Western Roman Empire , serving as the capital city of the Kingdom of Naples between 1282 and 1816 .	Western Roman Empire	Western Roman Empire	Kingdom of Naples	Kingdom of Naples

Thereafter , in union with Sicily , it became the capital of the Two Sicilies until the unification of Italy in 1861 .	Sicily	Kingdom of Sicily	Two Sicilies	Kingdom of the Two Sicilies	unification of Italy	Italian unification
Naples was the most-bombed Italian city during World War II .	most-bombed	Bombing of Naples in World War II	World War II	World War II

Much of the city 's 20th-century periphery was constructed under Benito Mussolini 's fascist government , and during reconstruction efforts after World War II .	World War II	World War II	Benito Mussolini	Benito Mussolini

In recent decades , Naples has constructed a large business district , the Centro Direzionale , and has developed an advanced transport infrastructure , including an Alta Velocità high-speed rail link to Rome and Salerno , and an expanded subway network , which is planned to eventually cover half of the region .	Rome	Rome	Centro Direzionale	Centro Direzionale (Naples)	Alta Velocità	Treno Alta Velocità	Salerno	Salerno	subway network	Naples Metro
The city has experienced significant economic growth in recent decades , and unemployment levels in the city and surrounding Campania have decreased since 1999 .	Campania	Campania
However , Naples still suffers from political and economic corruption , and unemployment levels remain high .
Naples has the fourth-largest urban economy in Italy , after Milan , Rome and Turin .	Rome	Rome	Milan	Milan	Turin	Turin
It is the world 's 103rd-richest city by purchasing power , with an estimated 2011 GDP of US$ 83.6 billion .	purchasing power	purchasing power parity
The port of Naples is one of the most important in Europe , and has the world 's second-highest level of passenger flow , after the port of Hong Kong .	port of Naples	port of Naples
Numerous major Italian companies , such as MSC Cruises Italy S.p.A , are headquartered in Naples .	MSC Cruises	MSC Cruises

The city also hosts NATO 's Allied Joint Force Command Naples , the SRM Institution for Economic Research and the OPE Company and Study Centre .	NATO	NATO	Allied Joint Force Command Naples	Allied Joint Force Command Naples
Naples was a full member of the Eurocities network of European cities .	Eurocities	Eurocities

The city was selected to become the headquarters of the European institution ACP/UE and was named a City of Literature by UNESCO 's Creative Cities Network .	ACP/UE	African, Caribbean and Pacific Group of States	City of Literature	City of Literature	UNESCO	UNESCO	Creative Cities Network	Creative Cities Network

The Villa Rosebery , one of the three official residences of the President of Italy , is located in the city 's Posillipo district .	Villa Rosebery	Villa Rosebery	President of Italy	President of Italy	Posillipo	Posillipo

Naples ' historic city centre is the largest in Europe , covering 1700 ha and enclosing 27 centuries of history , and is listed by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site .	UNESCO	UNESCO	World Heritage Site	World Heritage Site

Naples has long been a major cultural centre with a global sphere of influence , particularly during the Renaissance and Enlightenment eras .	Renaissance	Renaissance	Enlightenment	Age of Enlightenment

In the immediate vicinity of Naples are numerous culturally and historically significant sites , including the Palace of Caserta and the Roman ruins of Pompeii and Herculaneum .	Palace of Caserta	Palace of Caserta	Pompeii	Pompeii	Herculaneum	Herculaneum
Culinarily , Naples is synonymous with pizza , which originated in the city .	pizza	pizza

Neapolitan music has furthermore been highly influential , credited with the invention of the romantic guitar and the mandolin , as well as notable contributions to opera and folk standards .	Neapolitan	Neapolitan language	Neapolitan music	Music of Naples	romantic guitar	romantic guitar	mandolin	mandolin	folk standards	Canzone Napoletana

Popular characters and historical figures who have come to symbolise the city include Januarius , the patron saint of Naples , the comic figure Pulcinella , and the Sirens from the Greek epic poem the Odyssey .	Januarius	Januarius	patron saint	patron saint	Pulcinella	Pulcinella	Sirens	Siren (mythology)	Greek epic poem	Homeric Greek	Odyssey	Odyssey
According to CNN , the metro stop `` Toledo '' is the most beautiful in Europe and it won also the LEAF Award ' 2013 as `` Public building of the year '' .	CNN	CNN	LEAF Award	LEAF Award
Naples is the Italian city with the highest number of accredited stars from the Michelin Guide .	Michelin Guide	Michelin Guide

Naples ' sports scene is dominated by football and Serie A club S.S.C. Napoli , two-time Italian champions and winner of European trophies , who play at the San Paolo Stadium in the south-west of the city .	football	Association football	Serie A	Serie A	S.S.C.
